curves.name: BZT52C10 zener characteristic
curves.test_conditions: Ta = 25 degC, pulsed; BZT52C10 trace labeled 10 in Fig. 1; PD = 500 mW envelope shown in the figure
curves.page_reference: p. 3, Fig. 1, Zener Characteristics (VZ Up to 10V), 10 V trace

reverse_current.conditions: IR = 0.2 microA maximum at VR = 7.0 V, Ta = 25 degC

breakdown_voltage.conditions: VZ nominal at IZT = 5 mA, Ta = 25 degC; inclusive table bounds 9.50 V minimum and 10.50 V maximum

extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal reverse breakdown voltage VZ = 10.0 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA, not with the forward-voltage rating.

The BZT52C10 row gives VZ = 9.50 V minimum, 10.00 V nominal, and 10.50 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum Zener impedance ZZT = 20 ohm at IZT; maximum knee impedance ZZK = 150 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; and admissible IZM = 5 mA.
The BZT52C10 row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.2 microA at VR = 7.0 V and temperature-coefficient limits of 4.5 to 8.0 mV/degC at IZTC, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C10 trace labeled 10 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values from 0.5 mA through 10 mA; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.

The p. 3 plot states Ta = 25 degC, pulsed, and shows a PD = 500 mW envelope. This plotted pulsed envelope is preserved as the curve condition and is not substituted for the p. 1 maximum PD rating of 350 mW.
Maximum ratings include PD = 350 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 357 degC/W.

Capacitance is shown only as family-level typical curves in p. 3 Fig. 3 at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz, with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias curves; no tabulated BZT52C10 capacitance value is provided, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
The supplied datasheet covers the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 family; this extraction is restricted to the BZT52C10 row and its labeled 10 V curve.
